text:
ana: FYI PR ready: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/8120 — migration guide + SDK snippets. Need legal + security quick check on telemetry note and examples.

tom: spotted a raw-looking token in the Ruby example: `ENV['REDWOOD_KEY']='sk_live_476'` — will replace with `ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']='YOUR_API_KEY'`.

legal-team: please avoid wording like 'we may share' in telemetry section. Recommend: 'we collect operational metadata and retain for 90 days by default.' Add 'Legal reviewed: 2026-03-22' to PR.

sec: Also replace internal bucket/role names with placeholders (YOUR_BUCKET, YOUR_ROLE). No internal ARNs in examples.

docs-bot: preview queued for PR #8120. Link-check + a11y enabled.

tom: pushed commit b7f2f to sanitize snippets and replace ARNs.

docs-bot: preview finished for commit b7f2f — status: pass (one warning: svg missing alt).

ana: I'll add alt text and schedule merge after canary at 16:00 PT. Avoid merge during infra maintenance at 15:30.

legal-team: wording approved.

sec: ok from security after placeholder swaps.

docs-bot: canary scheduled at 16:00 PT.

ana: Merged at 16:08 PT after successful canary. Added redaction note in README and PR body.

legal-team: archiving review note for audit.
